newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian cotton mixed on rising new arrivals.
newsitem.headline: Indian cotton mixed on rising new arrivals.

text.p: Punjab cotton remained steady at the reduced level while Gujarat varieties suffered a fresh setback on the local cotton market on Friday, dealers said.
Gujarat cotton attracted fresh offerings following reports of rising new crop arrivals in the Gujarat region.

In spot deals Gujarat Kalyan (medium-staple) slid 100 rupees to 13,200/13,400 rupees per candy (355.56 kg) while Gujarat Sankar-4 (long-staple) fell to 19,000/19,500 rupees per candy from 19,500/20,400 rupees.
Punjab cotton was steady in limited activity but sentiment was subdued at the close.

Reports that the Indian government has extended the last date for the shipment of cotton quota allotted for export during the 1995/96 season upto December 31 had little impact on the market, dealers said.
